descriptionHtml: As part of the Electrolizer session organized to introduce the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering societies to the E22 batch, this presentation provided a comprehensive overview of IEEE and its student branch at the University of Peradeniya. The session highlighted the benefits of IEEE membership, ongoing projects, opportunities for technical and professional development, and ways new students can get involved in shaping their engineering journey through IEEE.
venue: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, DEEE Seminar Room, Faculty of Engineering
